tspan.tspan: Choosing the material on a work order compares it with sto
ck; if it is short with nothing expected, "No incoming recei
pts" is shown. Stock & requirements (ST03) shows it too. N
o purchase request is created automatically.
Enter material, receiving site, quantity, requested date and
the reason. No price or supplier. It becomes Draft.
Not possible unless a flow exists in Approval settings (MS
0B). It becomes Pending approval and the first step's appro
val group is notified.
The approver sends it back with a reason and it becomes S
ent back. The requester fixes it and requests approval agai
n without recreating it.
With several steps it becomes Approved only after the last
one; in between it stays Pending approval and moves to th
e next step.
Before conversion to a PO (Draft, Pending approval, Approv
ed, Sent back) it can be cancelled with a reason. The flow
ends here.
Pick a supplier and convert. A material purchase order (Draf
t, unit prices 0) is created with the lines carried over, and t
he request becomes Ordered.
Upload the supplier's quote, order acceptance or PO copy; t
he supplier and materials are matched. Check each line (m
atched / guessed / unresolved) and apply it to the form. If it
cannot be read, enter by hand.
Enter supplier, quantity, unit price and expected date, then
save. Amounts are calculated. It can be edited only while
Draft.
Not possible without an approval flow. It becomes Pending
approval and the approval group is notified.
The approver sends it back with a reason and the PO return
s to Draft. Fix it and request approval again.
Approved after all steps. From here supporting documents (
order copies, etc.) can be attached.
Only before ordering (Draft, Pending approval, Approved) ca
n it be cancelled with a reason. The flow ends here.
It becomes Ordered; an empty order date is set to today. Th
e open quantity shows as incoming in Stock & requirement
s and in the work order's material hint. An ordered PO cann
ot be cancelled.
The material arrives with a delivery note — not always all a
t once.
When receiving presses "Received", the whole open quant
ity is received and a material receipt is recorded per line. T
he PO becomes Received and the requester and creator are
notified.
Receive only what arrived, per line. Receiving more than or
dered is refused. When the totals are complete the PO beco
mes Received automatically.
When the supplier cannot send the rest, close the PO as Re
ceived with a reason. The missing quantity never enters st
ock and drops out of the incoming quantity.
Material bought without a purchase order (direct purchase,
brought in) arrives.
Enter material, supplier, receiving site, received date and q
uantity, then register. The unit is fixed to the material mast
er's unit. It cannot be edited afterwards.
Receiving uploads the delivery note (PDF/image) and AI ma
tches the supplier and each line's material. A matching mat
erial code settles it; names are matched step by step.
Exclude lines for another plant or accessories with "Do not
register this line". A line without a resolved material cann
ot be registered (nothing is created on its own).
The selected lines are registered in one transaction; if anyt
hing fails, all are rolled back. Corrected material and suppli
er spellings are learned for next time.
The receiving site's material stock rises by the received q
uantity and a stock movement is recorded. With no site, it g
oes to "no site" stock.
Optionally attach delivery-note copies to the receipt and or
der copies to the PO (from Approved on). The AI-read origina
l is attached automatically; if that fails, the registration stil
l stands.
On the work order step choose Outsourced as the execution
location and pick the subcontractor. No separate outsourc
e-order document is created.
Outsourced steps are listed (view only). Filter by subcontra
ctor or status and open the step from a row.
In the step's "Outsource schedule", enter the requested, e
xpected and received dates and the cost, and save; the list
reflects them.

svg.text: Purchasing — from requesting material to receiving it
